components.text:
Tame the animal first, then place it inside a medium chalk circle and cast its binding rite. While it is bound, the familiar grants its owner a bonus.

Only one familiar can be bound to a witch at a time.

Crouch and use your familiar to dismiss it. The $(b)summon familiar$(/b) rite calls it back.

Familiars shrug off fire, falls and drowning, and a fallen familiar is only dismissed, never lost.
